cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Approve the Harmless Version
cards.instruction: Get approval for a harmless version of your plan, then gradually reveal what that approval now commits them to.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: May I add one chair to the hall? I'll position it clear of the door.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. It's for the chair of our new tenants' committee. I'll seat the other members along the existing bench.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I approved a chair, not a meeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we should record that distinction. Sit in the new chair, please; as hall host, you can open the meeting by stating exactly what you approved.

reason: Turn B's scope objection into a formal meeting role while continuing precise room/record supervision.
